The AFP-V0-030 bar replay reports infrastructure failures separately; spec reading recorded.
body: From V1-1257 lane (PR #988). 7 INCOMPLETE forward rows on 2026-10-15 05:32-06:08Z (#905, #907, #908 x2, #909, #910 x2) each lack one shard whose hosted job failed at 'Set up job'; the AFP-V0-030 replay TRIPPED for 22 points (05:46-13:23Z). Reproduction: run 38686348902 (#908 queue). Expected: infrastructure failures before the job runs are recorded with a distinct reason and not counted as runner incompleteness (or counted separately). Actual: same INCOMPLETE reading. Any workflow change under .github/ needs owner AFP-V0-016 consent.
title: ci shadow: a hosted 'Set up job' failure makes a forward row INCOMPLETE and counts toward the AFP-V0-030 trip, indistinguishable from runner incompleteness
